known_issues.issue: Pygame dependency build failure on fresh Windows environments
known_issues.description: uv sync fails to build pygame from source due to missing MSYS2 and build dependencies (pacman not found). Pygame 2.6.1 wheels are available for Python 3.12 but not for Python 3.14.
known_issues.workaround: Pre-built pygame is available in .venv2 directory. Use '.venv2/Scripts/python.exe main.py' directly for testing.
known_issues.impact: Fresh environment setup requires pre-built dependencies or MSYS2 installation

functionality_verified: Block class with rotation and bounds
Physics engine center of mass calculation
No memory leaks or crashes detected

conclusion.summary: The Vector Brick Stacker Gravity Balance game successfully initializes and runs. All core functionality verified including physics engine, block spawning, scoring system, and AI interface. Extended runtime test (30 seconds) with 2618 AI steps and 158 blocks placed completed without crashes. The code structure is well-organized with proper separation of concerns. The application demonstrates stable performance under continuous AI interaction.
